about:
Maine Solar was founded in 1975 by Floyd Severn in Farmington, Maine. For nearly five decades, the company served as a cornerstone of Central Maine's solar community, helping homeowners and businesses pursue energy independence long before solar power entered mainstream conversation. Severn built the business on a foundation of honesty and expert knowledge, driven by a belief that Maine residents deserve clean, affordable power on their own terms.

The company specialized in residential and commercial solar photovoltaic installations across Central Maine. While specific facility details and headcount were not disclosed, Maine Solar operated as a local installer guiding customers through system design, permitting, and interconnection processes. Its work spanned the evolution of solar technology from early adoption to modern battery storage and net metering integration.

Maine Solar's customer base consisted of Maine homeowners and businesses seeking energy independence. The company served both residential and commercial sectors, providing solar solutions tailored to the region's climate and utility landscape. No specific industrial or institutional clients are named in the available records.

The company's distinguishing philosophy centered on honest, expert guidance and a commitment to empowering customers with affordable clean energy. In 2026, Aurora Roofing & Solar—established in 2009 by Troy Hull—acquired the Maine Solar name and certain assets, combining nearly two decades of roofing experience with solar expertise to continue the mission under new ownership.
